decisionsTitle: «Lista ascunsă»: the name, the glyph, a radio, the event's switch and numbers, its count tick, and «Arată public numărătoarea» on every event (amending §643, §632, §173)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02**, after BR-V2.62 reached production, of the registration page's new block (an outlined button with a switch glyph, «PUNE ÎN AFARA LOCURILOR», its caption cut off at the right of his phone): «Nu îmi place deloc cum arată bifa asta, trebuia să fie doar radio». Then: «nu vreau să scot pe nimeni de pe listă, ci doar să nu se pună la socoteală; de fapt mai punem bifă pentru „afișarea numărătorii”». Then: «Trebuie ca acest feature să se numească „Pune pe lista ascunsă” cu o iconiță specială cu un bandit (incognito), și la numărate trebuie să am bife dacă vreau să îi includ sau nu.» And: «trebuie să pot invita oameni direct pe lista ascunsă; și tot felul de bife dacă să îi pun la contul total sau nu; și direct din setările evenimentului să pot avea „folosește lista ascunsă” dedicată pentru BIB-uri date pe invitații.»

This amends §643 (the name, the glyph, the radio, the event's switch, the numbers, the ticks), §632 (the «Cine vine» count may include the hidden list when the event says so) and §173 (a second race-number sequence). Inviting people straight onto the hidden list is the invitations chain's tick, renamed at the batch, not this decision's.

**1. The name.** «În afara locurilor» is now **«Lista ascunsă»** / "Hidden list" in every word the club reads: the verbs «Pune pe lista ascunsă» / «Scoate de pe lista ascunsă» ("Put on the hidden list" / "Take off the hidden list"), the chip, the pill «Lista ascunsă: N», the editor's «pe lista ascunsă: N» beside the occupied places, the badge tooltip's «N pe lista ascunsă», the export's last column «Hidden list» (CSV and spreadsheet), the audit label «Pus pe lista ascunsă sau scos de pe ea», the dialogs' titles, bodies and toasts (reworded, the meaning unchanged), and the guide's task «Lista ascunsă: organizatori, pacemakeri, invitați», which gains the switch, the series and the two ticks. `BUSINESS.md`'s vocabulary, `AGENTS.md` §10.5, §10.6 and §15.11, `CLAUDE.md`'s two rows and `SETUP.md` §39 say the new words; the rules are the same. **Not renamed:** the column `registrations.outside_capacity`, its audit action `registration.outside_capacity_changed`, the code's `outsideCapacity` identifiers and the list's `outside=1` parameter — a column rename is a contract migration for a word, and a bookmarked filter keeps working. **Not on a public page.** «Lista ascunsă» is the backoffice's name: it appears on no public page, in no participant's email and in no participant-facing string. Publicly these people are «în afara locurilor anunțate» / "outside the advertised places" (see 7), and the note under «Cine vine» says so in those words: «Cei la start în afara locurilor anunțate (organizatori, voluntari, sportivi invitați) apar în tabel fără să fie numărați: numerele de mai sus numără locurile.» (it said «Organizatorii și invitații clubului…»). The public page marks nobody.

**2. The glyph.** `hiddenList` in `ACTION_ICONS`: a hat over round glasses, drawn as one path on the 24-unit grid in its own file (`shared/ui/IncognitoIcon.tsx`) — Material has no incognito glyph, and no browser vendor's asset is copied. It is on the block's heading, the row's chip (`HiddenListChip`, which imports the one file rather than the registry) and the list's pill. Not on the confirm button: `ConfirmDialog` draws its own tick on every confirm, and one dialog with a different glyph would be the exception the glyph rule forbids. `tests/unit/shared/action-icons.test.ts` now accepts a drawn glyph — a local file named after its identifier, one per glyph — beside `@mui/icons-material` files.

**3. The radio.** The sentence and the button became a `RadioGroup` of two (`HiddenListRadio`, a client island): «Se numără între locurile evenimentului» and «Pe lista ascunsă», the stored one checked, each a 44-pixel target whose words wrap at 320 pixels. A change opens the existing per-state dialog through the form's own submit (`requestSubmit()`); «Da» posts the same hidden `outside` value to `setOutsideCapacityAction`; «Anulează» sends nothing, and the form now dispatches `CONFIRM_CANCEL_EVENT` on itself so the radio shows the stored state again (a DOM event, because a Server Component passes the form no function). Once a submission ends the radio follows the page the action redirected to, moved or refused. The Organizer sees the two radios disabled. **The overflow** was the caption: an inline `caption` span inside a `Stack` aligned `flex-start` beside an unbreakable uppercase button; the caption is now a block paragraph with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`, the section has `min-width: 0`, and there is no button. Without JavaScript the radios cannot submit (the backoffice's dialogs need it anyway); the server refuses nothing it would not refuse otherwise.

**4. The event's group «Lista ascunsă»** (migration `0126_hidden_list`, expand only, generated by drizzle-kit, with its backfill as an `UPDATE` in the same file, which `yarn migrations:check` classifies as an expand), in the editor's «Lista publică a participanților» card under «Arată public câți așteaptă»:
- «Folosește lista ascunsă» (`hidden_list_enabled`, **off by default**; the migration switched it on for every event that already had a registration on the list, so nothing §643 showed disappears). On, the registration page draws the radio; off, it draws it only for a row already on the list, with the line «Lista ascunsă e oprită la acest eveniment: înscrierea poate doar ieși de pe ea.», and **the server refuses** putting anybody on the list under the event lock (`VALIDATION_ERROR` carrying `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, whose sentence names the switch). Taking somebody off is always open: «Debifat: nimic nu se schimbă pentru cei deja pe listă».
- «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la» (`hidden_list_bib_start`, **empty by default**). See 5.
- «Numără și lista ascunsă» (`hidden_list_counted`, **unticked by default**). See 6.

Beside the group, not in it, «Arată public numărătoarea» (`participant_count_public`, **ticked by default** — named for what it withholds, the participant count) acts on **every event**, whatever the switch says. See 6 and 8.

The two under the switch are shown only while it is ticked (`OnlyWhenTicked`, the `ShownWhen` the mode and the type use: hidden, still posted, read-only while hidden), and act only while it is on (`domain/hidden-list.ts`: `hiddenListCounting`, `hiddenListBibStartOf`); they are stored as posted whatever the switch says, so switching it off and on keeps the club's choices. Saved by the kit's discipline — the group's three by one marker (`event.hiddenList.present`), «Arată public numărătoarea» by its own (`event.participantCountPublic.present`), so a form without them edits none of the four — audited as `event.hidden_list_changed` with `from` and `to` naming only what moved, previewed, carried to the later dates of a series by a scoped save (each date's own trail row) and by «Repetă evenimentul» and a duplicate; the save expires the public pages as every event save does. Every help is one sentence under 200 characters in both languages.

**5. Race numbers (amending §173).** With a hidden-list start set and the switch on, `pickBibNumber` draws from **two series that never meet**: a row on the hidden list from its start upward, a counted row from `bib_start_number` — each the lowest free number in its series, so each in confirmation order. The hidden series runs up to the race's start when it sits below it, else to the ceiling; the race's runs up to the hidden start when that sits above it. Both the confirmation's draw and «Alocă numerele» use it. **A number once given stays** when a row changes list (§173: a printed bib is never renumbered). **The save's collision rule:** a start inside the race's capped series (`bib_start_number` … `bib_start_number + capacity − 1`; on an uncapped event, its first number) is refused naming the box (`fields.ts#hiddenListBandRule`), and so is one inside the desk's reserved spares (`assertHiddenListClearOfSpares`, which needs the event row); judged only while the switch is on. **A full series never refuses a confirmation:** when the race's series has run into the hidden start (more confirmed than the room, or a start the save did not see), the draw falls back to the next free number above, as every draw did before there were two. Unchanged: the print, the spares (still never drawn, still reserved after the highest number anybody has), and the desk's number typed by hand, which may be any free number as before.

**6. The public list (amending §632, §643).** «Arată public numărătoarea» off: «Cine vine» has no number in its title, no counted line, no «Apar cu numele și» count and no position column — a running position is a count — only the names (and the race number behind its own notice gate, §613), with the note's sentence about the title's number dropped. «Numără și lista ascunsă» on: the title and «confirmați» count everybody on the hidden list with a place, ticked or not (`countHiddenListWithPlace`: real rows only, confirmed among the confirmed, a hold among «în curs de confirmare» on a capped event only — an uncapped event still publishes no head count of held places, §32), the ticked hidden-list pending count in «Apar cu numele și», and the note that the hidden list is not counted is gone. **The places line, the free places and every capacity count never include the hidden list** — it takes no place, which is the point. **The rows never change because of either tick** (§32): which names appear is the person's tick and the notice's gates alone; an unticked runner on the hidden list is not even a «Participant (nume ascuns)» row, as before. The cached counts gained the key part `"hidden-list"` with the new shape. An event whose switch is off never counts the hidden list, whatever «Numără și lista ascunsă» says; «Arată public numărătoarea» acts on it all the same (8).

**7. Clean, fair, configurable — the public side.** While an event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on, the event page's places line — «N înscriși din M locuri» beside the register button (`RegistrationCta`, every state that draws it: open, full with a waiting list, full without one), the one place a visitor reads the places — carries one sentence: «Organizatorii, voluntarii și sportivii invitați pot fi la start în afara locurilor anunțate; ei nu ocupă din aceste locuri.» / "Organisers, volunteers and invited runners may be at the start outside the advertised places; they take none of them." It names nobody and says nothing of how many. Off, nothing; an uncapped event, which advertises no places and draws no places line, nothing. The switch is the event page's own row, whose cache key gained `"hidden-list"` with the row's shape (the switch and the two ticks), so no entry written before the columns existed is read as "off" after the release; every event save expires it. Nothing in the code reads a member flag or a staff role to decide a place: the hidden list's one exclusion is the audited column `registrations.outside_capacity`, set only by an Administrator's audited verb.

**8. «Arată public numărătoarea» on every event (the review round, 2026-10-02).** The owner asked for a tick on showing the public count («mai punem bifă pentru afișarea numărătorii») before the hidden list existed, and «configurable» means any event may keep its public numbers to itself — not only one that uses the hidden list. So the tick left the group: in the editor it sits beside «Arată public câți așteaptă», not indented and never hidden, with its own marker and its help; `hiddenListCounting` reads it whatever «Folosește lista ascunsă» says, so on any event, unticked, «Cine vine» has no «(N)» in its title, no «N confirmați — M cu numele afișat» line, no «în curs» words and no position column, and the rows stay as they are. «Numără și lista ascunsă» and the hidden list's number series stay under the switch. The column, its default (true, so nothing changes on production until the club unticks it on an event), the migration and the audit action `event.hidden_list_changed` are unchanged; the cache key part `"hidden-list"` already carries the column.

**Not changed.** The capacity formula and its one exclusion; the allocator, the transitions and the refill (§643); `kind` in no condition; the Organizer's rights (§289); the emails; the public list's disclosure gates (§396, §628, §634).

**Refused.**
- **Removing hidden-list people from the public list.** The owner: «nu vreau să scot pe nimeni de pe listă». The ticks change numbers, never rows.
- **Counting the hidden list in the places line** («150 de înscriși din 150 de locuri», the free places) when «Numără și lista ascunsă» is on: the line counts places, and the hidden list takes none; counted there, a full race would read over its capacity.
- **Renaming the column and the audit action**: a contract migration for a word.
- **The backoffice's word on a public page** («Pe lista ascunsă», a «hidden list» badge): the public reads «în afara locurilor anunțate», one sentence beside the places, and no row is marked.
- **A second capacity** for the hidden list: it has no limit of its own; the club decides each row, audited.
- **Renumbering anybody** when the series is set or a row changes list: a number once given is printed and emailed.
changelogLine: - **«Lista ascunsă»** — «În afara locurilor» is now the hidden list, with an incognito glyph and two radios on the registration's page; the event's settings gain «Folosește lista ascunsă», with the hidden list's own race-number series and «Numără și lista ascunsă» under it, and, on every event, «Arată public numărătoarea» (ticked by default) to keep «Cine vine»'s numbers off the page; while the switch is on the event page says beside the places that organisers, volunteers and invited runners may start outside the advertised places. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: «Lista ascunsă» on a registration's page is two radios, «Se numără între locurile evenimentului» and «Pe lista ascunsă», the stored state checked, under a heading with the incognito glyph; a change opens the existing per-state dialog, «Da» posts the same `outside` value to `setOutsideCapacityAction`, «Anulează» sends nothing and shows the stored state again, and the Organizer sees both radios disabled (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Putting a registration on the hidden list of an event whose «Folosește lista ascunsă» (`events.hidden_list_enabled`, off by default, switched on by migration 0126 for every event already holding such a row) is off is refused under the event lock with `VALIDATION_ERROR` carrying `HIDDEN_LIST_OFF`, whose sentence names the switch, and changes nothing; taking one off is allowed whatever the switch says (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

At 320 pixels the «Lista ascunsă» section, its radios' labels and its caption stay inside the screen with no horizontal scroll, and each radio's row is at least 44 pixels tall (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With the hidden list's own series set (`events.hidden_list_bib_start`) and the switch on, a confirmed row on the hidden list draws the lowest free number from that start and a counted row from `bib_start_number` up to the number before it, each in confirmation order, at the confirmation and in «Alocă numerele»; a number once given stays when the row changes list; without a series, or with the switch off, every row draws from the race's series; a full series falls back to the next free number above rather than refusing the confirmation (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The event save refuses a hidden-list start inside the race's series (`bib_start_number` to `bib_start_number + capacity − 1`, or the race's first number when uncapped), naming «Numerele listei ascunse încep de la», and one inside the desk's reserved spares; it judges neither while the switch is off (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The «Lista ascunsă» group's three settings are saved by one marker and «Arată public numărătoarea» by its own (a form without a marker edits none of its fields), all four audited as `event.hidden_list_changed` naming only what moved, carried by a scoped series save, «Repetă evenimentul» and a duplicate; the two under the switch are shown only while it is ticked, and «Arată public numărătoarea» is shown on every event beside «Arată public câți așteaptă» (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Cine vine» shows the same rows whatever the ticks say; with «Numără și lista ascunsă» on and the switch on, its title and «confirmați» count every real hidden-list registration with a place (holds among «în curs de confirmare» on a capped event only) and the not-counted note is gone; with «Arată public numărătoarea» off — on any event, the hidden list on or off — it shows no number in the title, no counted line, no «în curs» words and no position column; the places line and the free places never count the hidden list; with the switch off the hidden list is never counted (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A registration on the hidden list (`registrations.outside_capacity`) stays out of every term of the capacity formula whatever the event's «Folosește lista ascunsă», «Numără și lista ascunsă» and «Arată public numărătoarea» say: the free places, the places line and the waiting list's turn never count it (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

While an event's «Folosește lista ascunsă» is on, its places line («N înscriși din M locuri») is followed by «Organizatorii, voluntarii și sportivii invitați pot fi la start în afara locurilor anunțate; ei nu ocupă din aceste locuri.» (English likewise) in every state that draws the line; off, or on an uncapped event, nothing; no public page says «lista ascunsă» or "hidden list" (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Lista ascunsă»: the name, an incognito glyph, a radio, the event's switch, the hidden list's own numbers and its count tick, and «Arată public numărătoarea» on every event
